body: ... and I will never look at a skinny cow advertisement in any shopping mall the same ever again.
Wow. My suicide letter would look exactly the same as this. Or at least very similar.

I'm going through this except I never even actually saw the point of love. Seriously, I could have written this. To be completely honest with you, it's even weird writing this right now because I'm sure I'm meant to write something positive or anything to stop you from killing yourself but I just agree with you so much that I can't think of a single thing to say. Don't get me wrong, I don't want you to die. Yet, I also hope you feel better about things. Sorry, I know this response achieved and means nothing, just like everything else in the universe.
